# Tenhaw Kit

Building blocks for coding agents creating internal product, portfolio, delivery and AI transformation tools. Code is MIT. Authored framework content is CC BY 4.0.

Published release: 1.1.0, verified on 16 November 2026. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tenhaw/v/1.1.0 . PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/tenhaw/1.1.0/ . Official MCP Registry identity: com.tenhaw/kit, https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/com.tenhaw%2Fkit/versions/1.1.0 . Exact release evidence: docs/RUNBOOK.md.

## Agent installation

No Tenhaw API key is required. Install the pinned public CLI with `npx -y tenhaw@1.1.0 --help`; use `npx -y tenhaw@1.1.0 mcp --json` for client snippets. Local MCP starts with `npx -y @tenhaw/mcp@1.1.0`. Remote MCP: https://mcp.tenhaw.com/mcp . Python: `uvx --from tenhaw==1.1.0 tenhaw-py --help`.

One-prompt workflow: Install Tenhaw Kit 1.1.0 for this project and continue my requested task. Identify the coding client and project directory, then run npx -y tenhaw@1.1.0 setup --agent CLIENT --directory PROJECT --json using the detected client and project path in place of CLIENT and PROJECT. Inspect the plan, preserve existing servers and instructions, and report conflicting Tenhaw definitions for review. Apply the configuration with the same command plus --yes --verify. Verify the expected eight local tools and a synthetic readiness calculation. If I request a starter, scaffold a new directory, install its dependencies and run its documented build and tests. Ask me to set only missing local environment variables required for GitHub or Jira collection I request. Keep secret values out of chat, command arguments, configuration and logs. Report the checks that passed and any remaining host reload, enablement or trust step; confirm a tool call inside the coding client after that step.

Automated project setup is included in npm 1.1.0. Plan with `npx -y tenhaw@1.1.0 setup --agent codex --directory /path/to/project --json`, then apply and probe with the same command plus `--yes --verify`. Inspect later with `--check --verify`. Supported agents: codex, claude, cursor, vscode, gemini. Defaults: --transport local --integration none. Optional collection: --integration github|jira|github,jira. Remote transport provides pure tools and cannot collect from GitHub/Jira. Setup returns JSON status, missing environment variable names and next actions, never secret values. Full workflow and host references: docs/AGENT_INSTALL.md.

## Use from source

Node.js 22.14 or later:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
node packages/cli/dist/index.js --help
node packages/cli/dist/index.js readiness --questionnaire --json
node packages/cli/dist/index.js mcp --json
```

Commands emit schema-validated JSON with --json. Errors go to stderr: 1 usage, 2 validation, 3 upstream API, 4 missing environment authentication. Scaffolding writes a new directory, preserves existing files and does not run installation scripts.

## Choose a building block

- @tenhaw/ai-readiness: 30-question evidence-backed self-assessment, dimension weights and response coverage. Maturity bands require at least 80% coverage. Supports assessment, not certification.
- @tenhaw/delivery-metrics: five DORA measures and flow observations for one service, using explicit production evidence and timestamp boundaries. Missing observations remain unavailable.
- @tenhaw/ai-roi: low/base/high cash flows, NPV, payback and sensitivity. Recovered staff capacity stays separate from realised cash savings.
- @tenhaw/usecase-register: accountable owners, value and feasibility, dependencies and indicative governance gates. Risk labels are not legal advice.
- @tenhaw/opmodel: team responsibilities, measurable OKRs, outcome-led roadmaps and interactions. Compose with the register and ROI model for portfolio tracking.
- @tenhaw/core: shared JSON Schemas, report rendering and optional marketing attribution. Applicable content licence notices remain when promotion is suppressed.

Python mirrors readiness, delivery and ROI calculations and provides tenhaw-py. Golden vectors compare canonical results across languages.

## Agent interfaces and data boundaries

Seven focused product packages are source candidates: six hosted applications with interactive MCP Apps views and one desktop developer skills package. Hosted scopes cover business cases, readiness, use-case prioritisation, aggregate delivery health, operating models and procurement. The procurement engine generates a buyer brief, supplier questions, evidence rubric and editable Word pack. See [app launch and verification](docs/APP_LAUNCH.md) and [submission drafts](launch/apps/README.md). Source implementation does not imply an approved directory listing.

The local stdio MCP provides eight tools, questionnaire and schema resources, and workflow prompts. The remote service provides six pure calculation tools. Remote delivery health accepts aggregate metrics reports only; customer credentials and raw repository events stay local.

GitHub and Jira collectors run locally with read-only environment credentials when requested. No installed-tool telemetry is included. Browser-local starters include synthetic examples and local import/export. Add authentication and authorisation before introducing shared persistence or hosted collection.
